text:
sam: Heads-up: I'm going to land a Terraform change to allow an inline ExternalSecrets template for team-scoped Vault paths (so we can use `secret/data/<team>/<app>` without per-app manifests). Pinging for RBAC/rotation concerns.

maya: can you paste the TF diff? want to make sure we don't accidentally grant wide Vault access.

sam: current plan — add a `values` override to the helm_release in infra/modules/external-secrets. Example values I'm proposing:
```yaml
externalSecrets:
  template:
    enabled: true
    pathTemplate: "secret/data/{{ .Values.team }}/{{ .name }}"
```

li: how does that look in Terraform?

sam: using the module we do something like:
```hcl
module "external_secrets" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra//modules/external-secrets"
  team   = var.team
  enable_template = true
  extra_values = yamlencode({externalSecrets={template={enabled=true,pathTemplate="secret/data/${var.team}/{{name}}"}}})
}
```

jeff: Important: Vault policy must be scoped to `secret/data/<team>/*` and not `secret/*`. I'll prepare a policy change:
```hcl
path "secret/data/${team}/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
```
Also avoid `write` unless absolutely needed.

maya: rotation question — will this make secrets auto-rotate if we update Vault?

sam: ExternalSecrets will sync at the configured interval and update k8s secrets when the value changes. It doesn't handle Vault dynamic lease renewals. For dynamic creds we should use Vault's database/creds engine or the Vault CSI/agent. This change only templates static KV paths.

li: example ExternalSecret CR for clarity?

sam: yep, quick example to show template usage in CR (the controller will render the path):
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: my-app-secret
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1h"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: team-vault
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: my-app-secret
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: "{{ .name }}" # templated by controller using pathTemplate from chart
```

jeff: Action: I'll create the Vault policy change + limited service account role. I'll also add notes to the rotation runbook that dynamic creds need different handling.

maya: I'll update the infra docs + set `enable_template = false` by default so we can roll per-team. also will add a terraform plan check in PR.

sam: I'll gate the TF apply behind a feature flag and do canary rollouts per-cluster. Rolling to dev first then staging.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for external-secrets in cluster dev-02 (release r-8452). Watching helm diff and CRD status.

jeff: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — if anyone sees vault audit logs spike ping here.

sam: will monitor. I'll post the PR link in this thread once it's up.
